question: If the volume of a cylindrical vessel is 21.560 litres. If the radius of the base of the cylinder is two-fifth times of its height, find the total surface area of the cylinder (in {cm}² ). (Take pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume = 21.560 litres = 21560 cm³

Given r = (2/5)h ⇒ h = (5/2)r

Volume = πr²h ⇒ (22/7) × r² × (5r/2) = 21560

⇒ (55/7)r³ = 21560 ⇒ r³ = 2744 ⇒ r = 14 cm

⇒ h = (5/2) × 14 = 35 cm

Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h)

= 2 × (22/7) × 14 × (14 + 35) = 4312 cm²

**∴ The correct answer = 4312 cm²**
